title: Agreeing vote count
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs, and let $x$ be an element of that cube. The agreeing vote count of $f$ at $x$ is the number of coordinates $i$ for which the sign $x_i$ equals $f(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs
